overview: This Senate resolution thanks the teachers of the United States and recognizes their contributions to the country's civic, cultural and economic well-being. It notes National Teacher Appreciation Week, held May 4 through May 8, 2026, which aims to raise awareness of teachers' work and promote respect for the profession. The resolution encourages students, parents, school leaders and public officials to recognize that week. It is ceremonial and does not change any law. The Senate agreed to it by unanimous consent on May 11, 2026.
for: Supporters say publicly thanking teachers recognizes the vital role they play in students' lives and communities.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law, pay or school funding.
